Road closure plans for Cockermouth

by Cumbria Crack
14/10/2026
in News
Share on FacebookShare on Twitter

A road closure is planned for a Cockermouth road for an urgent utility project.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

The project, by SP Electricity North West, will start on the A5086 Lamplugh Road, on Monday October 26, subject to weather and site conditions.

It is likely to last for five days.

Vehicles, including blue badge holders, will also be prohibited from waiting, loading and unloading at any time.

The restriction applies to the west side from the road’s junction with Brigham Road, extending north for about 60m.

Exceptions apply for emergency service vehicles

Pedestrian access to premises on or next to the road will be maintained.
